title: Query forms of a word list
description: Reads a plain word list with no project and returns the words that satisfy a query expression, including phon(...) and env(...) patterns, which PanGloss evaluates against the grammar given by --grammar; unsegmentable words are counted and sampled, never dropped.
usage: Usage: motif query corpus forms --corpus <words.tsv|folder> (forms where <expression> | forms --where <expression> | forms --query-json <file|->) [--grammar <path>] [--project <fwdata>] [--thorough] [--segments <file>] [--fold-case] [--split-hyphens] [--limit <n>] [--segment-test engine|identity] [--group-by cause|parse.state|readings|shape] [--sum tokens] [--sample <n>] [--seed <n>] [--write-words <file>] [--with-counts] [--force] [--what-if-retire <ids>] [--count-by morph-seq] [--adjacent] [--by-morph] [--twin <template>] [--baseline-grammar <path>] [--json]
